explanation: Finds the top five BDCs with at least 50 debt holdings (investment_type = 'DEBT') that have the highest proportion of those debt holdings carrying a non-null, non-zero PIK rate.
raw: {"sql": "SELECT bdc, COUNT(*) AS total_debt_holdings, SUM(CASE WHEN pik_rate IS NOT NULL AND pik_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pik_debt_holdings, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pik_rate IS NOT NULL AND pik_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS pik_share FROM holdings_v WHERE investment_type = 'DEBT' GROUP BY bdc HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY pik_share DESC LIMIT 5", "explanation": "Finds the top five BDCs with at least 50 debt holdings (investment_type = 'DEBT') that have the highest proportion of those debt holdings carrying a non-null, non-zero PIK rate."}
sql: SELECT bdc, COUNT(*) AS total_debt_holdings, SUM(CASE WHEN pik_rate IS NOT NULL AND pik_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pik_debt_holdings, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pik_rate IS NOT NULL AND pik_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS pik_share FROM holdings_v WHERE investment_type = 'DEBT' GROUP BY bdc HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY pik_share DESC LIMIT 5
